components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:

## Summary

I implemented create-time telephone normalization for `POST /api/owners`, following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions.

**What the change does:** On owner creation, the telephone is normalized by stripping every non-digit character, then required to be exactly 10 digits. The normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned; input that isn't exactly 10 digits after stripping is rejected with 400.

**Files changed:**

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Removed the DTO-level `pattern: '^[0-9]*$'` constraint on `telephone`. That pattern would have rejected any non-digit input (e.g. `(608) 555-1023`) at bean validation with a 400 *before* normalization could run, contradicting the "strip then check" requirement. Updated the description to document the new behavior. (`minLength`/`maxLength` retained.)

2. **`src/main/java/.../function/owner/NormalizeOwnerTelephone.java`** (new) — A single-method step that reads the validated `@Val OwnerFieldsDto`, strips non-digits (`replaceAll("\\D", "")`), and:
   - writes the 10-digit value back onto the request in place (so `BuildOwner` persists it and the responder returns it), or
   - throws `MethodArgumentNotValidException` on field `telephone` when the digit count ≠ 10, reusing the existing escalation handler to produce the standard 400 with `schemaValidationErrors`.

3. **`src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`** — Wired `normalizeTelephone` into the create pipeline between `validate` and `build` (under the same `transaction` governance). It's create-only, so `PUT` is untouched.

4. **`OwnerRestControllerV1Tests.java`** — Added 3 tests: normalization of `(608) 555-1023` → `6085551023` (201), and 400 rejection for too-few and too-many digits.

One tradeoff worth flagging: relaxing the shared DTO pattern also relaxes digit-only enforcement on the `PUT` (update) path, which has no normalization step. The spec scoped this to create only, and no update tests depend on that pattern, so I kept the change minimal — but if you'd like update to normalize too, adding the same step to `owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml` would do it.
